div.div:
bootstrap_npm()
Same fail-closed order as cargo, plus:
REQUIRES a usable [ai_review].
Absent OR present-but-disabled both
refuse startup, because npm has no
cargo-vet-shaped fast path, so
nothing could ever be forwarded.
Logs error! naming that, then bails.
-> NpmScanner, NpmAppState, npm_router
NO SIGHUP: logs a warning and
installs no signal handler.
Tickers: npm OSV advisory, cache eviction

display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#666666, #959595); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div: Why tickers exist at all: the advisory re-check runs on every request for an already-clean artifact, so an upstream outage must not become a proxy outage. On the intended startup order both stores sync before the listener binds, so a cold start already includes that download.

box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #b85450;

div.div: Fail-closed in practice: a missing plugin binary, a non-executable plugin (Policy checks readable only, a known defect), an absent bwrap while plugins or AI review are configured, an unreachable advisory feed at first sync, or an npm deployment without a reviewer all stop startup rather than degrade it.
